description: A/B-testing brain: one record per published short-form post, correlated back to the rendered video variant it came from, tagged with A/B dimensions, and joined to performance metrics. Append-only, versioned, designed to grow as an automated posting loop reads/writes it.

repo.paths_are: repo-relative to the pipeline repo root

inputs.publer_posts: .ab-tmp/publer-posts-raw.json (14 posts synced from Publer; NO API key stored here)
inputs.metrics_screenshot: Publer post-analytics table, page 1 of 2, captured ~2026-07-21 15:11 -05:00 (10 of 13 analytics rows). Page 2 (3 rows) + the newest 2026-07-21 post were not in the screenshot -> metrics 'pending'.
variant_metadata: renders.nosync/videos/ab-tests/manifest.json (A/B families: no-answer, dont-narrate, speed, one-question, cliffhanger, mascot)
renders.nosync/videos/ready-to-post/*/caption.txt (verbatim caption bodies used for the standard quiz posts)

conventions.reach_rate: stored as the raw string shown by Publer (e.g. '3.1K%', '12.8%', null). TikTok reach-rate values are unreliable here because the follower base is ~0 (near-zero denominator).
conventions.metrics_source: 'screenshot' = read from the 2026-07-21 analytics screenshot; 'pending' = not yet captured (fill on next analytics pull).

match_confidence.high: exact source render pinned: caption body matches a ready-to-post caption.txt verbatim (unique question-type fingerprint), or it is the one brand-intro asset.
match_confidence.medium: variant FAMILY is certain from the caption, but the exact render is 1 of 2 indistinguishable siblings (video-1 vs video-2) that the caption cannot disambiguate. See source_candidates.
match_confidence.low: even the family is uncertain; needs human confirmation. See notes + source_candidates.

variant_fields.family: standard | no-answer | cliffhanger | dont-narrate | speed | one-question | mascot | intro-promo
variant_fields.narration: full | none | no-question-vo | no-options-vo (VO treatment; all posted-so-far are 'full')
variant_fields.hook: score-CTA ('Comment your score') | comment-CTA ('Comment your answer') | brand ('Follow so you don't miss one')
variant_fields.question_types: ordered play-order types. For no-answer/cliffhanger these are taken from the family's render tiers (identical across video-1/video-2), not the caption.
variant_fields.num_questions: count of quiz questions (0 for the brand promo)
